music.prompt: Energetic, bouncy, playful modern electronic at exactly 120 BPM for a product launch motion graphics video: a punchy kick on every beat, snappy claps, rubbery plucked bass, bright marimba-like plucks and playful percussion hits; crisp, clean and joyful. No vocals and no long silences. It starts immediately with a sparse pulse and quick hits for the first 8 seconds, then a big drop at 8 seconds into a full bouncing groove, an extra lift at 22 seconds, the fullest part from 30 seconds, and it winds down cleanly in the last 3 seconds without a big final hit.

word.text: a punchy soft pop, a bold word landing on screen

bounce.text: a tiny soft rubber ball bounce, short and light

spread.text: a quick paper whoosh, cards spreading apart

snap.text: three quick thin threads snapping, light plucky snaps

windup.text: a short rising swoosh, a ball winding up to jump

drop.text: a deep punchy impact with a bright shimmer, a ball slamming down and a logo appearing

slam.text: a quick tight whoosh-thump as bold text snaps in

chips.text: five tiny bubbly pops in quick succession

hop.text: a soft rubber ball bounce with a tiny wooden click

launch.text: a springy boing, a ball launched high into the air

fall.text: a short falling whistle ending just before an impact

agent.text: a fast whoosh-snap, a bold colourful card cutting in

scribble.text: a quick marker pen scribble on paper

knob.text: a smooth toggle switch sliding with a soft click

success.text: short warm two-note success chime, soft

whoosh3d.text: a deep airy swoosh, a camera flying around big 3D letters

type.text: fast soft typing on a mechanical keyboard for one and a half seconds

logo.text: a soft bouncy thud, a card landing with a little bounce

tag.text: a soft punchy pop, a word landing

zip.text: a smooth pen stroke drawing a long line, soft swish

plink.text: a bright playful plink, a ball landing perfectly on top of a letter, with a soft sparkle

note.text: a quick marker pen scribble on paper
